children: SLB received four well construction contracts from Aramco to support oil and gas development in Saudi Arabia.
Under the co5ntracts, SLB will build more than 450 wells over a three-year term, with an optional extension of up to two years, the energy technology company said Thursday.
SLB said it will manage end-to-end well construction services, combining digital drilling workflows with automated drilling, evaluation, fluids, cementing and completions products and services.
The awards expand SLB's integrated well construction business in Saudi Arabia and are an example of growing customer adoption of integrated delivery models, the company said.
